proposals.evidence: Full sphuṇṭati explicitly gives Bshk phuṇḍ full-blown/flower, Chil phundo flower, Gau phono and Shina Kohistani phuṇu. These support the selected Dardic nasal flower responses, preserving vowel nasalization, aspiration/fricative notation, retroflex stops/flaps and final inflection. The complete same-family slash response is retained. The nominal flower meaning is explicit; the ultimate sphuṭ/sphar root choice and local transmission remain qualified. Exact response: pʰūṇḍo.
